blocks.text: This Vehicle Maintenance Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of {{date}}, by and between:
Provider agrees to perform the following maintenance and repair services on the Vehicle:

items: {{scope_of_services}}
Provider shall use new OEM or equivalent-quality parts unless otherwise approved by Owner.
Provider shall perform all work in a professional and workmanlike manner.
Service Start Date: {{service_start_date}}
Service Frequency: {{service_frequency}}
Estimated Service Duration: {{service_duration}}
Service Location: {{service_location}}
Total Contract Value: {{total_contract_value}}
Payment Schedule: {{payment_schedule}}
Payment Method: {{payment_method}}
Provider shall invoice Owner {{invoice_frequency}} for services rendered.
Owner agrees to pay all invoices within {{payment_terms}} days of receipt.
Provide Vehicle in safe, accessible condition for service.
Maintain valid insurance and registration.
Notify Provider of any changes in Vehicle ownership or condition.
Grant Provider reasonable access to the Vehicle for scheduled services.
Comply with all terms of this Agreement.
Provider warrants that all parts and labor will be free from defects for a period of {{warranty_period}} from the date of service.
Provider warrants that services will be performed in a professional manner consistent with industry standards.
Provider will provide written estimates for any repair work exceeding {{estimate_threshold}}.

blocks.text: Provider's total liability under this Agreement shall not exceed {{liability_cap}} or the total amount paid by Owner to Provider under this Agreement, whichever is less.

items: Either Party may terminate this Agreement with {{termination_notice}} days written notice.
Upon termination, Owner shall pay Provider for all services performed up to the termination date.
Provider shall return the Vehicle in the condition required by this Agreement.

blocks.text: Any disputes arising from this Agreement shall be resolved through {{dispute_resolution}} in {{governing_state}}.
